title: Core Set 2019 Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who reflects on his past ambitions as only first steps toward a greater future.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who grafted the Planar Bridge into himself.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: A device Tezzeret grafted into his body, causing his spark to flare across the Multiverse.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The totality of planes, which the Great Mending healed.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon whose power was unraveled by the Great Mending and who sought to be restored to his former glory.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: The event that healed the Multiverse and unraveled Nicol Bolas's power.

entities.name: Isareth the Awakener
entities.description: A necromancer who raises the dead to work.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane a speaker intends to claim as a throne once intruders are gone.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A scholar who calls the alpine moon a rare and fascinating phenomenon.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: One who sees the dragon as the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: An enthusiastic observer of great beasts such as the Gigantosaurus.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: An empire whose most sacred sites are guarded by more than prayers.

entities.name: Belligerent
entities.description: A ship on which Malcolm serves as navigator.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: An elder dragon, sister of Nicol Bolas and survivor of the Elder Dragon War, the most vicious of her kin.

entities.name: Goreclaw
entities.description: A fearsome beast called the Terror of Qal Sisma, whose name has an untold origin.

events.summary: Tezzeret recalls grafting the Planar Bridge into himself, feeling his spark flare beyond his body.
events.quote: When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body.

events.summary: The Great Mending healed the Multiverse but unraveled Nicol Bolas's power.
events.quote: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas works tirelessly to restore himself to his former glory.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas would not rest until he was restored to his former glory.

events.summary: Palladia-Mors survived the Elder Dragon War.
events.quote: Survivor of the Elder Dragon War.

relations.quote: When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself
You don't want to know how she got that name.
